about_the_game:
Help a single dandelion seed find its place to grow on a journey across the world, in this serene yet precise, hand-crafted platformer from Pink Sakura Studios.


A touching, wordless adventure about finding your place in the world, told through the simple, elegant journey of a single seed. Beneath its gentle surface lies a deeper metaphor, about resilience, healing, and the courage to keep moving forward when the winds of life grow heavy.

A vast and varied world to explore, from frozen caverns to sun-scorched plains, filled with challenging routes and hidden groves. Each environment reflecting struggles and moments of calm familiar to anyone who has faced the weight of mental health challenges.

A beautiful and calming soundtrack, featuring almost half an hour of original music with gentle piano melodies and ethereal soundscapes to lose yourself in.

Bloom.

The controls are minimalist and intuitive - simply drift, float, and harness the breeze - but with layers of expressive depth to master, where every current is an opportunity. Frequent checkpoints let you ride the wind again and again as you learn to navigate the world's beauty and its dangers.

It's time, little seed. Just let go. The wind will carry you - toward growth, toward healing, toward hope.

name: On The Wind's Breath Demo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: lowest tested was ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 1024 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 5625u
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: A sound card
  • Additional Notes: Make sure to turn on your Computer Device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 11
  • Processor: worked perfectly fine on ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: well, worked perfectly fine on 5625u
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: A better sound card
  • Additional Notes: Make sure to turn on your pocket nuclear generator as this will drain your tiny integrated GPU

short_description: In “On the Wind's Breath”, play as a dandelion seed, navigate obstacles, find fertile soil, take control of the wind, grow into a flower. Simple graphics, intuitive controls, narrative experience. Beware of unsuitable surfaces. Soothing soundtrack, a journey through various regions.
